verdict.rationale: The evidence describes an MCP server and plugin API that let external AI agents read and act on Penpot design files. Community AI plugins are also mentioned. None of this documents a native, in-product feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. These are external-agent and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
